lead.headline: UMass Lowell takes first as Vermont stumbles
lead.deck: Lowell won by 17 at Hampton as an underdog and moved to the top of the power rankings. Vermont lost twice, the second time by 18 at home.
body: UMass Lowell went to Hampton on Friday as a 2-point underdog and won 72-55. Jayden Harris had 28 points and nine rebounds. Earlier in the week the River Hawks lost 78-68 at Cincinnati, comfortably inside a 29.5-point line. They are 5-2, first in the standings, and 146th in our model at plus-1.5 points per 100 possessions, the only America East team rated above zero.

Monday's power rankings swapped the top two: Lowell up to first, Vermont down to second, both with a score of 0.0. The rest of Vermont's week settled it. The Catamounts beat Brown 84-71 as 4.5-point favorites last Saturday, then lost 98-88 at Siena as 4-point underdogs on Tuesday and 75-57 at home to Merrimack on Friday. Will Davies had 19 against Brown and 23 points, six rebounds and eight assists at Siena. The Catamounts are 3-5 and 225th in our model.

Binghamton had the league's best week. The Bearcats beat Army 67-46 as 1-point home underdogs, with 16 points and 20 rebounds from Demetrius Lilley, then won 90-83 at Lehigh as 8.5-point underdogs. Jeremiah Quigley had 22 points, six rebounds and seven assists in Bethlehem, and KiJan Robinson added 19. They rose from sixth to fifth and are 5-3.

UAlbany lost all three of its games and still had the league's biggest scoring night. Tyler Jones scored 32 in a 91-81 loss at Canisius and 26 in a 78-75 home loss to Mercyhurst. At Syracuse, Ollie Engen scored 23 in a 74-53 loss that covered a 24.5-point line.

The league went 6-14. Maine's 90-86 win at Le Moyne as 1.5-point underdogs, with 23 from Darius Lopes and 21 points, nine rebounds and five assists from Ayden Evans, was the week's third road win. Per the league's Week 3 release, America East took the AE-Metro Challenge.

column.label: Look Ahead
column.title: Three games worth your week
body: **UMass Lowell at American, Saturday, 4 p.m.** American is favored by 6.5. The River Hawks lead the America East power rankings and American leads the Patriot League's, so this is first place against first place. Radford visits Lowell the next afternoon.

**Vermont at Colgate, Saturday, 1 p.m. on FloSports.** Colgate is favored by 2.5, and our model makes it 4.7. The total is 142.5. Colgate is the Patriot League's top-rated team in our model, which is a hard place to stop a two-game skid.
**Princeton at Vermont, Thursday, 6 p.m.** No line yet. The Catamounts play at Hofstra on Sunday first, so this is their third game in six days.

notes.headline: New Hampshire's long night
notes.body: The Wildcats scored 27 points in a 73-27 loss at Seton Hall on Tuesday. Three days earlier they lost 50-47 at New Haven as 2-point favorites.

notes.headline: Bryant loses by one
notes.body: The Bulldogs lost 58-57 at Marist as 2.5-point underdogs. Keegan Harvey had 19 points and six rebounds, and Eric Chatfield Jr. added 15.

notes.headline: NJIT's home loss
notes.body: The Highlanders were 1.5-point favorites at home against Manhattan and lost 81-70. David Bolden had 19 points and seven assists. NJIT is 1-8.
